Thanks for the ping, Rishi. Hi Taylor/Priya — great to meet you. I’m the Redwood PDM; Hannah will be the PSM for this engagement. A few quick notes on ACE eligibility so we can move fast:

1) Marketplace listing & co-sell path: AWS needs a published Marketplace listing (we can list a private-priced product for now) + primary contact for procurement.
2) GTM signal: Pilot metrics (active seats, token usage) and commercial intent (SOW) are helpful — you already provided that.
3) Security posture: SOC2 summary is fine for initial intake; AWS may ask for a longer RAID or evidence link.

Action items (proposed MAP):
- Week 0 (this week): PDM/PSM intro + intake form to ACE (owner: Karthik)
- Week 1: Draft Marketplace listing + pricing band (owner: Marissa)
- Week 2: AWS ACE intake review + sign-off (owner: aws-ace@amazon.com)
- Week 3–4: Co-sell readiness call + procurement playbook (owners: Hannah & Priya)

Taylor — can you confirm procurement timeline and point the HubSpot record if you have it? I’ve cc’d the ACE address to start the intake thread.

Thanks,
Karthik
